candidate.codeAnchorPolicy: codeCommit is the authoritative candidate demo source identity for fresh V00-V05. Following source-pin/source-target/handoff and Docs/AssemblyShadow review commits are metadata-only under the committed source verifier.

reproduction.preservationPolicy: The protected reproduction branch/head and its unfixed behavior source/runtime pins must not move. Local Validation runs the same unfixed behavior through the separately authenticated tooling-only successor declared in validationTooling; this does not change reproduction runtime/Player behavior or promote the tooling branch to behavior authority.

performanceReference.policy: Preserve its own committed old-profile pins. Do not install the candidate runtime into this reference.

primaryValidation.scope: Authenticated Apple Bee graph planning, reversible declared-input retention, fail-closed retention controls, managed changed-action/cache-hit provenance, split reproduction tooling, exact M07 fixed-byte/bootstrap policy bridge, exact M07 outer failure restoration for scene/settings, direct CodeGen test-asmdef dependency regression, and portable/host-Clang tool regressions. Not Unity, Apple Player, current-source M07/runtime acceptance, M08, or human acceptance.

retentionRepair.policy: Retain every declared native source by raw SHA-256 and raw length while separating content identity from reversible storage representation. Generated C/C++/ObjC sources use content-addressed zlib-v1 only when smaller; semantic request/DAG/PCH/header/response/plist evidence stays raw by default. Successful attempts independently authenticate the retained store before finalization.

managedCacheRepair.failure: Fresh native provenance and retention passed, but the managed verifier required a changed Bee graph even when the exact required Player Csc/ILPP chain and DLL outputs were legitimately reused from an unchanged Bee cache.
managedCacheRepair.policy: At begin, retain bounded exact reusable Player Csc chains from pre-existing Bee DAGs, including graph/action, recursive response closure, compiler dependencies/tools, Csc output, and reachable downstream DLL bytes. At end, require selected-chain evidence to remain byte-identical and require exactly one chain to reach the exact path/hash/size of the DLL captured as an input to the fresh Player. Prefer a unique changed-graph proof when present. Cache proof never claims fresh Csc execution and is not the legacy prior-proof reuse route.

managedResponseScopeRepair.failure: Schema-2 cached verification attached every response discovered from every Csc action in a Bee DAG to each required cache graph. Seven unrelated StandaloneOSX_CodeGen response files legitimately changed during staging and incorrectly invalidated two required assembly cache chains whose own recursive response closures, dependencies, outputs, reachability and fresh Player bindings remained unchanged.
managedResponseScopeRepair.policy: Schema-3 retains and verifies response stability per matched required compiler action using exactly the recursive responseSources returned by bounded @response expansion. Graph-wide response paths may be recorded as audit-only responseAuditSources but are not acceptance inputs unless they are in that selected action's recursive closure. Graph identity, action transcript, source set, compiler/tool/reference dependencies, Csc output, downstream reachability, exact fresh Player path/hash/size binding, unique-chain selection, pre-existing-output requirements, cache budgets and no-fresh-Csc-execution claim remain unchanged and fail closed.

reproductionToolingRepair.failure: The protected reproduction Player built successfully, but its project-local older native provenance tool applied obsolete global macro equivalence and rejected the real 446-action graph. Its managed capture bridge also predates the current schema-3 cache proof. Candidate-owned diagnostic replay accepted the same native graph under current policy, but replay was not fresh build provenance.
reproductionToolingRepair.policy: Historical repair record. The first tooling successor authenticated nine validation replacements and eleven required validation dependencies while preserving the protected reproduction behavior/runtime pins. It remained subject to fresh Local Validation.

reproductionToolingCompatibilityRepair.failure: The authenticated first tooling successor combined the current schema-3 H1ManagedSourceProvenance bridge with the protected historical H1ManagedSourceProvenanceTests.cs consumer, which references the removed nested Capture type and fails Unity compilation with CS0426.
reproductionToolingCompatibilityRepair.policy: The successor removes the obsolete H1ManagedSourceProvenanceTests.cs and its .meta, exactly matching their absence from the reviewed candidate source anchor. Deletions are explicit authenticated tooling operations, not implicit exceptions. V00 verifies the exact nine replacement plus two deletion delta, verifies each deleted path is absent from the candidate source anchor, authenticates the eleven required tool blobs, and audits the assembled tracked Editor/Test-Editor C# set for removed managed-source API consumers before build acceptance.

m07FixedBootstrapRepair.failure: Real Unity M07 policy validation rejected AssemblyShadowDemo.H1CountEarlyStartup::LoadOrdinaryWitness as an unapproved bootstrap reflection entrypoint even though its byte acquisition was already authenticated by the FixedAssemblyBytes site h1-count-ordinary-witness-image.
m07FixedBootstrapRepair.policy: Keep the global BootstrapIsolationRule and shared package pin unchanged. The project declares exactly two target-qualified bootstrap entries for the single reviewed callsite: the source/precompile fixed-byte evidence token and the compiled fixed-image SHA-256. The existing schema-4 FixedAssemblyBytes site remains authoritative for method hashes, operation index, provider identity/semantic variants, image path and image SHA. A real Unity Editor integration regression validates the combined policy and rejects another image target; no targetless or method-only H1 exemption exists. Invoke-M07Build.ps1 snapshots the actual M07Bootstrap scene, AssemblyShadowSettings.asset and EditorBuildSettings.asset before the first Unity workflow call and restores those exact bytes only on failure before rethrowing.

m07EditorTestAsmdefRepair.localEmpiricalEvidence: After the bounded one-line asmdef fix, real Unity 2022.3.62f2 candidate compilation passed with zero errors and M07FixedByteBootstrapPolicyTests passed 2/2. The previous source authority then failed closed as expected.
m07EditorTestAsmdefRepair.policy: Retain the direct CodeGen reference because the M07 integration test directly imports HybridCLR.AssemblyShadow.CodeGen and Unity asmdef references are non-transitive. This does not broaden runtime or Player dependencies. A bounded Primary regression requires exactly one direct CodeGen reference and preserves Editor/test-only asmdef constraints. Fresh V00-V05 remain mandatory under the new source anchor.
